Authentication and camera settings

Computer: receive up to G128 · G32 controls

Both devices can send and receive G32, G64 or G128, independently of the authentication role. Choose the outgoing grid on each screen; phones initially select G64. Choose a smaller grid when alignment is difficult. Choose one verifier and one key holder. Start both devices with 32 repetitions. Short proofs are for development; increasing repetitions increases proof size and work. Sampling and processing may take longer than the selected intervals.

The trained neural corrector will be checked when you start.

Camera exposure & focus

For glare, try a small negative exposure compensation if available. These controls change camera acquisition; no brightness filter is applied to captured pixels. Manual exposure and focus values become available after the camera confirms Manual mode.

Turns advance automatically. When a G32 ACK appears, turn the phone so the sender can read it, then aim back at the next data matrix. During handoff, the last ACK and next message start repeat until the peer responds. Only a matching RS+CRC-valid packet advances the exchange.

Choose a grid while receiving, before the next outgoing message starts automatically. To resize a stalled message, stop and restart both devices.
